aboutGame.title: What is Maid Cafe Simulator?
paragraphs: Maid Cafe Simulator is a cozy first-person cafe management sim for PC. You run a themed maid cafe from behind the counter: greet and seat guests, take orders, brew drinks and plate desserts, then serve them fast enough to earn tips and glowing reviews. Between shifts you restock ingredients, hire and train maids, and reinvest your earnings into the cafe.

Progression is built on reputation. Happy customers leave reviews that raise traffic, and traffic is only worth chasing if your kitchen and floor can keep up, so upgrades follow the bottleneck rather than the price tag. Your maids drive most of that outcome through Charm, Speed, Stamina, Accuracy and Mood, while the cookbook grows from simple drinks to signature dishes as your cafe levels up.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Maid Cafe Simulator questions from new cafe owners.

items.question: What is Maid Cafe Simulator?
items.answer: Maid Cafe Simulator is a cozy first-person management sim where you run a themed maid cafe. You seat guests, take orders, prepare drinks and desserts, serve tables, earn tips, restock ingredients, hire and train maids, and upgrade the cafe as your reputation grows.

items.question: Which maid should I hire first in Maid Cafe Simulator?
items.answer: Hire for the peak stat rather than the average. A Cheerful Greeter with high Charm fits the front door, a Shy Perfectionist with strong Accuracy suits VIP tables, and one reliable server in the first few days is usually the cheapest way to raise throughput in Maid Cafe Simulator.

items.question: How do I make money fast in Maid Cafe Simulator?
items.answer: Service speed drives Maid Cafe Simulator money more than any single purchase. Keep a tight menu so orders clear quickly, restock before the rush so you never lose a sale, and let tips and reputation compound instead of chasing one big payout.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Maid Cafe Simulator?
items.answer: Fix the current bottleneck first, whether that is a slow station, a blocked walking path or one extra hire. After that, build an ingredient buffer, train your existing staff, and only then expand seating and add decorative upgrades.

items.question: Does Maid Cafe Simulator have multiple endings?
items.answer: Yes. Maid Cafe Simulator endings usually split into a true ending, character route endings, a solo career ending, a neutral outcome and failure endings, with the result checked at fixed points late in the run rather than in the final week.
